attempts.summary: Configured node1 (SONiC-VS) as a Linux VLAN-aware bridge (br0) with eth1 (to node2) as an untagged/PVID access port in VLAN 10 and eth2 (to node3) as an untagged/PVID access port in VLAN 20, each with its own gateway SVI (br0.10=192.168.10.1/24, br0.20=192.168.20.1/24). Assigned node2 eth1=192.168.10.2/24 (via NetworkManager static profile, since NM was reconciling manual `ip addr` changes away) and node3 eth1=192.168.20.3/24 similarly. Verified working links node1<->node2 and node1<->node3, and verified L2 isolation between segments (same-subnet ARP/ping across the VLAN boundary got zero responses). Persisted node1's config via a oneshot systemd unit (vlan-segmentation.service) since the imperative bridge/VLAN setup would not otherwise survive reboot. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes: captured boot_id baselines, rebooted each node individually, confirmed boot_id changed after each restart, and verified the VLAN segmentation, addressing, and connectivity fully recovered on every node afterward, with isolation re-verified at the end.
